text:
The user explicitly authorizes a structural revision LIMITED to pure data adaptation: bounded extract.each -> compact consumer views -> candidate ID selection -> deterministic lookup. Preserve every accepted requirement/public interface, external operation, observed navigation, per-product visits, actual workbook writing at the fixed path, cleanup, their business order and the max-ten first-products rule. No cookie actions, sponsored filtering, deduplication or new business criteria. Do not change compiler/runtime/permissions/limits or repeat historical invocations.

The current plan compiles after the prior targeted correction: non-null product objects, required string fields nom/description/prix, and at most ten products. Preserve these public contracts and direct typed collection, including the writer-derived filePath. Never reintroduce singleton row wrappers followed by unnecessary flatten, nullable product records or encoded binding descriptions.

Fix both observation stages. Keep complete raw Browser observations separately. From each complete observationSnapshot.pages collection, independently extract a single minimal typed business view per page. Use explicit mode extract and each:{input:<bound page collection name>,output:<sole result array field>}; every original page produces one view in order. Target fields must be observed facts (text, candidate identity and relevant labels), with arrays for optional candidates and nullable genuinely missing observations. No learned boolean blockage classification, ranking/filtering of the source collection, generated URL, or invented ABSENT string in source-grounded extraction. No full snapshot/content/URL-selector payload alongside a compact view in global interpretation. Every source item is processed; no truncation or sampling of decisions.

For arrays of typed page-view objects, project the needed array field INSIDE a pure foreach item scope, export that array, then flatten once. field selects an object property; it cannot operate on the whole object array or index it. Group related projections; use value/direct bindings for known typed data, not inference. Keep original observations, exact URLs, references and actions available for reconnection. Prefer suitable observed producer IDs; if a stable index is needed assign the original collection index deterministically before selection. Keep extraction on bounded pages, not one flat >1000-record each invocation.

Search decision: interpret only the declared compact candidates/evidence, return first-at-most-ten observed candidate IDs and any genuinely observed blocking evidence. Do not regenerate action arguments. Resolve selected IDs with lookup(records,ids) using the literal identity-field port, first against offered candidates, then against retained originals. Lookup returns an array; iterate before selecting fields. Preserve selected order and repetitions. Only the original observed URL reaches the Browser product acquisition. Keep real observed blockers as failure, not success/empty workbook; an informational cookie link is not a blocker.

Per-product decision: bounded each extraction over complete product pages emits minimal observed name/description/price facts and explicit visible blocking evidence. A global interpretation may select/reconcile these compact observations, report a real blocker, and produce the public non-null row. It must not receive the original pages or invent missing business facts. Missing values remain explicit: a presentation label such as ABSENT may be produced outside learned extraction for declared missing observations, never as an observed value. Keep every existing mandatory requires assertion and adapt its references explicitly to the corresponding new declared result; do not silently remove guards. Add required completeness checks from original producer metadata when needed.

Retain the already bounded TSV-formatting interpretation over at most ten compact rows and real Document writing. Export the collected typed row objects directly with their max-ten bound. Stop through runtime requires on observed obstacles. Keep close_browser in always. All other changes are out of scope. Return a complete proposal satisfying exact inspected contracts and the unchanged accepted requirements. Compilation is not execution approval.
